C03/S03 second halves: meta_tests.end was written only when a week was due, so growth was unmeasured six days in seven, and without `finished` every in-flight pass was indistinguishable from one that skipped its week. And deferred_to_operator was never written by anything, so the guard could not tell a proper handover from an abandoned finding.

drift_verified_independently: Group 3 was asked to break today's central change and could not. Rows are compared against compose(), which reads the whole working journal and rebuilds the FILING axis on every fold, so a pending event that moves anything is red before anyone folds it. Every other top-level key is still compared. The head is verified against events[seq-1]['chain'], and chain is a running hash (state.py:690), so matching it at seq authenticates the whole prefix rather than one line. A forward head cannot anchor, so the only non-current head that can is an older one -- the one relaxation the docstring names, and nothing else slipped through. write_ledger's refusal is live in every production path (check_journal=False appears nowhere outside test_pipeline_schema.py). Nuance, not a finding: the `seq == 0 and chain == ""` branch anchors by fiat against any journal, so a ledger folded under a fresh QA_STATE_DIR anchors green and is caught by the rows instead; the docstring credits the wrong half of the check for that one case.
